## Where they live

| Repository | What it is |
|---|---|
| [MyFeeds-AI__Investor_Relations](https://github.com/the-cyber-boardroom/MyFeeds-AI__Investor_Relations) | The investor pitch, its source, and the documents behind it. Publishes investor.myfeeds.ai. |
| [myfeeds-ai](https://github.com/the-cyber-boardroom/myfeeds-ai) | The engine: the pipeline that produced the posts recovered here — RSS ingestion, entity extraction, graph building, persona selection, output. |

Both are public and open source. `investor.myfeeds.ai` is published from the first; the second is the pipeline that generated every persona briefing in [the recovered archive](../archive/index.md).

**The exception to indexing rather than copying** is anything that exists only in the Internet Archive. That has no owner left to defer to, so this repository holds it — see [the archive](../archive/index.md), where every item records the capture it came from.
